name: Beat
author: E. T. Carter
description: Two concentric ring patterns beating against each other — a slow moiré rosette blooming and folding as the centres drift apart, crisp bright bands threading through near-black. Pure interference, hypnotic and graphic.

params.label: Ring frequency
params.effect: How tightly the rings are spaced; low is bold wide rings, high a fine weave.

params.label: Detune
params.effect: Scale mismatch between the two patterns; this is what creates the moiré — 0 nearly cancels it.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How far and fast the two centres wander; 0 holds the rosette still.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Sharpness of the moiré bands; high is hard-edged, low is soft.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls one ring centre; 0 ignores the mouse.
